relative_position: (variable.u.x * math.cos((variable.particle_random_1 * 360 + variable.particle_age * variable.spin + ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd)) * 300)) + variable.v.x * math.sin((variable.particle_random_1 * 360 + variable.particle_age * variable.spin + ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd)) * 300))) * (variable.r * (1 - ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd))))

(variable.u.y * math.cos((variable.particle_random_1 * 360 + variable.particle_age * variable.spin + ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd)) * 300)) + variable.v.y * math.sin((variable.particle_random_1 * 360 + variable.particle_age * variable.spin + ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd)) * 300))) * (variable.r * (1 - ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd))))

(variable.u.z * math.cos((variable.particle_random_1 * 360 + variable.particle_age * variable.spin + ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd)) * 300)) + variable.v.z * math.sin((variable.particle_random_1 * 360 + variable.particle_age * variable.spin + ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd)) * 300))) * (variable.r * (1 - ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd))))

size: variable.size * (0.1 + (1 - ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd))) * 0.12) * (1 - math.pow((variable.particle_age / variable.particle_lifetime), 4))

variable.size * (0.1 + (1 - ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd))) * 0.12) * (1 - math.pow((variable.particle_age / variable.particle_lifetime), 4))

color.interpolant: math.clamp(0.2 + ((variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd) - math.floor(variable.particle_random_2 + variable.particle_age * variable.spd)) * 0.75, 0, 1)
